text: 87年生。
en: Born in 1987.

text: 浪漫主义，理想主义，完美主义者。
en: A romantic, an idealist, a perfectionist.

text: 年轻时候觉得40很老了。
en: When I was young I thought forty was very old.

text: 年轻还爱照镜子。
en: When young I also loved looking in the mirror.

text: 某天看到合影里的自己，没法看，从此年龄定格在28岁。
en: One day, seeing myself in a group photo, I could hardly bear to look; from then on my age was frozen at twenty-eight.

text: 即不能用一根丝袜把自己吊死去沙哈拉流浪，也不能卧轨听火车呼啸面朝大海春暖花开，年华是抓不住的光，医美是握不住沙，想通了，任容颜老去，真心永远年轻吧。
en: I could neither hang myself with a single silk stocking to go wandering in the Sahara, nor lie on the railway tracks to hear the train whistle past, facing the sea with spring blossoms in bloom; youth is light one cannot grasp, cosmetic medicine is sand one cannot hold. Having seen through it, I let my looks age, but my true heart stays forever young.

text: 潇洒是笑看人生路。
en: To be free and easy is to smile at the journey of life.

text: 人生苦短，毫无意义可言，是我们赋予了人生存在价值。
en: Life is short and bitter, utterly without meaning; it is we who have given life its worth.

text: 一路摸着石头过河，满身伤痕，双眼含泪，头顶的星空依旧璀璨，脚下的路仍是道阻且长，心底的光…
en: All along I felt for the stones to cross the river, my body covered in wounds, my eyes brimming with tears; the starry sky above still shines brilliant, the road beneath remains long and hard, the light in my heart…

text: 忽明忽暗。
en: Flickering on and off.

text: 被需要是一种幸福。
en: To be needed is a kind of happiness.

text: 幸福是灵魂的香味。
en: Happiness is the fragrance of the soul.

text: 责任感让我坚强着给自己打气。
en: A sense of responsibility makes me stay strong and cheer myself on.

text: 劳动最光荣。
en: Labour is the most glorious.

text: 要为社会做贡献。
en: I must contribute to society.

text: 像一个寻找火种的原始人，承载着全村活下去的信心、力量和希望。
en: Like a primitive man searching for fire, carrying the confidence, strength and hope for the whole village to survive.

text: 是的。
en: Yes.

text: 生活就是为了活着。
en: To live is simply to keep on living.

text: 一直坚持网文创作。
en: I have always kept up writing online fiction.

text: 读大学时候是14、15岁小姑娘喊我叔叔。
en: When I was at university, fourteen- and fifteen-year-old girls would call me uncle.

text: 现在是14、15岁小姑娘叫我哥哥。
en: Now fourteen- and fifteen-year-old girls call me big brother.

text: 哦。
en: Oh.

text: 我永远28。
en: I am forever twenty-eight.

text: 我越来越听不懂她们的言语，也不知道她们在坚持什么，总有人放弃，也总有新人光顾。
en: I understand their words less and less, and do not know what it is they hold on to; some always give up, yet new ones always come along.

text: 她们的关注点都不是我想表达的心声点。
en: What they focus on is never the true voice I wish to express.

text: 就这么奇怪的羁绊着。
en: And so we remain strangely bound to one another.

text: 她们给我画画给我写字走到哪里都带着我，我就像护身符，就像黑暗里的一道光，就像前世水中的倒影，像天边的彩虹折射在三棱镜里的颜色，是能触及的最近的偶像，是世间竟然真实的存在。
en: They draw pictures for me, write words for me, and take me everywhere; I am like an amulet, like a beam of light in the darkness, like a reflection in the water from a past life, like the colours of a rainbow at the horizon refracted through a prism; I am the closest idol they can reach, a being that truly exists in this world.

text: 一直是这样。
en: It has always been this way.

text: 每个人独自诉说着自己的心事，两条平行线却觉得懂得。
en: Each person tells of their own worries alone, yet two parallel lines feel they understand each other.

text: 伤痕文学，哭哭啼啼。
en: Scar literature, all weeping and wailing.

text: 后妈式写作，永远惨兮兮，博同情。
en: Stepmother-style writing—forever wretched, fishing for sympathy.

text: 人设不能崩，可怜可怜我TT.
en: The persona must not be allowed to break; pity me, TT.

text: 诶。
en: Eh.

text: 未完待续。
en: To be continued.

text: 10点了。
en: It's ten o'clock.

text: 加班完毕。
en: Overtime finished.

text: 码点字。
en: Type a few words.

text: 我们这代人也算魔幻的。
en: Our generation could be called rather surreal.

text: 我记得小学老师突然说，你们以后惨了，读大学国家不包分配了。
en: I remember my primary school teacher suddenly saying, 'You lot are done for; by the time you go to university the state will no longer assign you jobs.'

text: 我小时候也是蹲大院的。
en: When I was little I too grew up in a big courtyard compound.

text: 我以前一直以为只有江南的大院才是亭台水榭，满池荷花，白玉兰路灯，吊脚楼和飞檐走壁，红墙绿瓦黄砖，黑白灰青瓦，湖泊假山吊桥，三层小土楼，青苔布满…
en: I used to think only the courtyard compounds of Jiangnan had pavilions and waterside terraces, ponds full of lotus, magnolia street lamps, stilted buildings and flying eaves, red walls, green tiles and yellow bricks, black, white and grey-blue tiles, lakes, rockeries and suspension bridges, three-storey little earth houses, moss covering everything…

text: 一群野孩子假扮解放军和土匪，四处飞奔，打打杀杀。
en: A gang of wild children pretending to be the People's Liberation Army and bandits, dashing about, fighting and killing.

text: 冬天，跳下水，把湖面的冰砸碎扔来扔去。
en: In winter we would jump into the water and smash the ice on the lake surface, throwing it back and forth.

text: 那时候小学放学，不用家长接送，按线路排队，六年级拉着一年级，其他小盆友跟着走，都自己走回家。
en: Back then, after primary school let out, no parents came to collect us; we queued by route, sixth-years leading first-years, the other little ones following, and all walked home by ourselves.

text: 每人挂个小钥匙。
en: Each of us wore a little key.

text: 双职工，父母要工作，所有学习全凭自己。
en: With both parents working, all our studying was left entirely to ourselves.

text: 我有印象的是什么肯德基奖学金，华罗庚金杯赛，黄冈题库，王后雄化学，王玉梅词汇，9校联考，很多记不得了。
en: What I remember is the KFC scholarship, the Luogeng Hua Gold Cup competition, the Huanggang question bank, Houxiong Wang's chemistry, Yumei Wang's vocabulary, the nine-school joint exam—many I can no longer recall.

text: 大学是没包分配了。
en: University no longer assigned jobs.

text: 但大学扩招了。
en: But university enrolment expanded.

text: 杭大没了。
en: Hangzhou University is gone.

text: 但浙大大了。
en: But Zhejiang University grew.

text: 我们这代见证了中国经济的高速发展。
en: Our generation witnessed the rapid development of China's economy.

text: 我小时候电视台百花齐放，为了竞争收视率，什么国家的动画片都有。
en: When I was little, television stations let a hundred flowers bloom; to compete for ratings they showed cartoons from every country.

text: 小神龙俱乐部，大风车，龙珠，机器猫，一休哥，变形金刚，新世纪福音战士，高达，加菲猫，巴巴爸爸，太多了，都是电视上看的。
en: Little Shenlong Club, Big Windmill, Dragon Ball, Doraemon, Brother Ikkyu, Transformers, Neon Genesis Evangelion, Gundam, Garfield, Barbapapa—too many to count, all watched on television.

text: 启路文具店，贝塔斯曼书友会，想不起来了。
en: Qilu Stationery Shop, Bertelsmann Book Club—I can't recall the rest.

text: 我越长大越觉得世界越来越大，视野越来越宽阔，海阔凭鱼跃，天高任鸟飞。
en: The older I grew, the vaster the world seemed, the broader my horizons: the sea is wide for fish to leap, the sky high for birds to fly.

text: 小时候我们还是文化精贵，物质贫瘠的时代。
en: When we were little, ours was still an era of refined culture and material scarcity.

text: 我的老数学老师是初中生，他那个年代初中毕业就可以教小学了。
en: My old maths teacher was a secondary-school graduate; in his day, finishing junior high was enough to teach at primary school.

text: 我家里没什么好玩的，有几个玩具我都放柜子里摆着。
en: There wasn't much fun to be had at home; the few toys I had I kept displayed in a cabinet.

text: 好玩的都在学校，在外面。
en: All the fun was at school, out of doors.

text: 不像现在。
en: Not like now.

text: 我娃幼儿园的时候，我问我娃幼儿园好玩吗？
en: When my child was in kindergarten, I asked whether kindergarten was fun.

text: 他说不好玩。
en: He said it wasn't fun.

text: 我说为什么不好玩？
en: I asked why it wasn't fun.

text: 他说玩具还没有家里多…
en: He said there were fewer toys than at home…

text: 我毕业的时候就业岗位很多。
en: When I graduated there were plenty of jobs.

text: 那时候铁饭碗有点日子一眼望到头一层不变没什么本事的意思。
en: Back then, an iron rice bowl felt like a life you could see to the end at a glance, unchanging, with no real skill to it.

text: 北上广深大家的奔头。
en: Beijing, Shanghai, Guangzhou and Shenzhen were everyone's goal.

text: 本科够用了。
en: A bachelor's degree was enough.

text: 读研的真不多。
en: Few really went on to postgraduate study.

text: 名校光环也不显。
en: The halo of a prestigious school was not prominent either.

text: 那时候互联网还是蓝海。
en: Back then the internet was still a blue ocean.

text: 大神也爱逛论坛。
en: Even the experts loved browsing forums.

text: 普通院校的娃肯专研，一样可以雄起当大神，拿高薪。
en: Children from ordinary colleges who were willing to study deeply could just as well rise up and become experts, earning high salaries.

text: 我表哥那天和我说，这个社会现在成了精英才能过得很好，普通人很难过的世界了。
en: The other day my cousin said to me that society has now become a world where only elites can live well, and ordinary people find it hard to get by.

text: 对了，我读小学的时候周边无房也可以读。
en: Oh, and when I was in primary school you could enrol even without a house nearby.

text: 所以我同学里还有小商小贩外来务工的娃。
en: So among my classmates there were also children of small traders and migrant workers.

text: 真的就是就近原则。
en: It really was just the principle of attending the nearest school.

text: 后来变成要买房6年才能读了。
en: Later it changed, so you had to have bought a house six years prior before you could enrol.

text: 那天听人聊，目前学区内最便宜的老破小500万，其他都在2000万左右。
en: The other day I heard people talking: at present the cheapest old, dilapidated, small flat in the school district is five million, and the others are all around twenty million.

text: 困了。
en: I'm sleepy.

text: 人生体会大概是我们算是末代精英教育和平民教育的产物了。
en: My sense of life's lessons is probably that we are the product of the last generation of both elite and mass education.

text: 广开民智又平等自爱，我们还有不同阶层的同学伙伴，还知道勤俭节约，吃苦耐劳，艰苦朴素，勤劳勇敢。
en: With public intellect broadened and equal self-respect, we still had classmates from different strata, and we knew to be thrifty and industrious, to endure hardship, to be plain and simple, diligent and brave.

text: 以上。
en: That is all.

text: 爬山已经爬到一半了，怎么也得努力上到山顶 ^_^^_^
en: I'm already halfway up the mountain, so I simply must strive to reach the summit ^_^^_^

text: 我的40岁生日是一个人在英国的旅行中度过的，39岁我感觉自己的状态很不好，迷茫，自我否定，我需要安静的独立的思考我是谁这个简单又复杂的问题，所以我辞掉高薪高职的工作，留老公和二个孩子加公婆在家，一个人去了英国游学了一年。
en: My fortieth birthday was spent alone, travelling in Britain. At thirty-nine I felt my state was very poor—confused, full of self-denial. I needed quiet, independent time to ponder the simple yet complex question of who I am, so I resigned from my high-paying, high-ranking job, left my husband, two children and my parents-in-law at home, and went to Britain alone to study for a year.

text: 人生是在不断思考努力否定重塑中去体会和总结，加油。
en: Life is understood and summed up through constant thinking, effort, denial and reinvention. Keep going.

text: 就是吧，你感觉这个世界不再属于你。
en: It's just that you feel this world no longer belongs to you.

text: 以前你总有一种感觉，就算波折事情终究变好；作为小镇做题家的你，考个试认个证稍作准备就没有大问题：怎么吃都不胖；怎么熬夜喝酒第二天正常上班该干嘛干嘛；只要努力就有回报；父母亲身体还可以，只是吵架有点烦；跟儿子关系亲密，也算半个好朋友；有一种比上不足比下有余的五线城市中产优越感；日子嘛还过得不错…
en: Before, you always had a feeling that even through setbacks things would eventually turn out well; as a small-town exam-crammer, you'd just sit an exam, get a certificate, do a little prep and there'd be no big problem: you could eat anything and never gain weight; stay up late drinking and still turn up to work fine the next day, doing whatever needed doing; effort would be rewarded; your parents were still in decent health, just a bit annoying when they argued; you were close with your son, almost half a good friend; you had the smug self-satisfaction of a middle-class resident of a fifth-tier city—better off than some, worse off than others; life, well, wasn't bad…

text: 现在感觉一切都是反着写了…
en: Now it feels like everything is written backwards…

text: 哎呦，还没到40岁，不知道是什么人生体会，等到了40岁我再来回答这个问题吧！
en: Ouch, I haven't reached forty yet, so I don't know what life lesson that is; I'll come back and answer this question once I turn forty!

text: 会怀着感恩的心去“体验和学习新事物”，感恩愿意给你这个机会的人和平台。
en: I would approach "experiencing and learning new things" with a grateful heart, grateful to the people and platforms willing to give you that chance.

text: 即便再标榜“人生不应限于年龄”的人，到了一定年龄也不得不承认：“体验和学习新事物的机会”是稀缺资源，它更多地向年轻人倾斜。
en: Even those who profess that "life should not be limited by age" must, upon reaching a certain age, admit that "opportunities to experience and learn new things" are scarce resources, tilted more towards the young.

text: 有时候不是中年人不爱学习或者不敢冲动，而是整个社会不给机会。
en: Sometimes it is not that middle-aged people dislike learning or dare not be impulsive, but that society as a whole offers no opportunity.

text: 比如我今年刚刚换了新工作，从一个已经没落的行业进入到另一个还有两年活头的行业，能转行的原因也是因为之前的工作经验，我甚至觉得自己在工作方面已经被社会淘汰了。
en: For example, I just changed jobs this year, moving from an already declining industry into another with only about two years of life left; the reason I could switch careers was my previous work experience, and I even feel I have already been eliminated by society when it comes to work.

text: 只是进入公司之后，发现集团更大的业务布局在智慧城市和基于大数据采集之上的城市生活平台，其合作伙伴不再是一个个公司而是省市政府。
en: Yet after joining the company, I found the group's larger business layout lies in smart cities and an urban life platform built on big-data collection, whose partners are no longer individual companies but provincial and municipal governments.

text: 这种新的机会和体验，简直是天大的惊喜。
en: Such a new opportunity and experience is simply a tremendous pleasant surprise.

text: 当我以一个新入行的中年人姿态进入整个体系中时，任何一次和大数据相关的业务探索，我都是怀着感恩的心去学习、思考和实践。
en: When I entered the whole system as a newly inducted middle-aged person, in every business exploration related to big data I studied, thought and practised with a grateful heart.

text: 尤其是与我对接的所有同事都是比我年轻15岁以上的年轻人，即便他们并没有“给你个机会”的心思，我依旧抱着“学一点就是赚一点”的心态在工作。
en: Especially since all the colleagues I work with are young people more than fifteen years my junior; even though they had no intention of "giving you a chance", I still worked with the mindset of "learn a bit and you've earned a bit".

text: 你要说人到中年还在为了保住工作学习新东西也太心酸了吧，人家体验的都是玩乐的新项目：什么抖音、小红书、tiktok；什么冲浪、潜水、滑板…
en: If you say that a middle-aged person still learning new things just to keep their job is rather sad, well, what others experience are new, playful pursuits: things like Douyin, Xiaohongshu, TikTok; things like surfing, diving, skateboarding…

text: 如果有机会，我当然也希望体验以上内容啊，财务自由之后我第一件事就是把那些没玩过都玩玩。
en: If given the chance, of course I would want to experience the above too; once I am financially free, the first thing I would do is try out all those things I have never played.

text: 可是作为一个还在工作的中年人，功利性特别强的我，最在意的还是：有人给我发着工资，让我学习并体验更新的东西，相当于赚钱学技能，这些技能以后就是我自己的了，我实在是太感恩了。
en: But as a middle-aged person still working, with a strongly utilitarian streak, what I care about most is this: someone pays me a salary to learn and experience newer things—it is like earning money while acquiring skills, and those skills will be mine afterwards; I am truly so grateful.

text: 发自肺腑的。
en: From the bottom of my heart.
